program.code:
def control(obs):
    h = obs['hitch_deg']
    target = obs.get('target', {})
    bearing = target.get('bearing_deg', -150) if target.get('in_sight') else -150
    desired = max(-18, min(18, (bearing + 180) * -0.22))
    steer = max(-35, min(35, 2.0 * (h - desired)))
    return steer, -0.25, 170
